correctness.rationale: Explicit 91/252/168 cell complex and signed face operators satisfy d1*d2=0; exact Smith factors 1^153,2^1,0^14 yield H2=Z14 and H1=Z8+Z2, with connected C0. The 168 GL3(F2) actions preserve the graph and signed chain complex. Sum-of-trajectories identifies rational H1 with the graph cycle module via rank([d1;T])−rank(d1)=8. Cellular Lefschetz plus direct mod-101 kernel action agree for every element. Classical PSL2(7) character table identifies the computed character with the 3+3bar+8 rational module.

value.rationale: The Fano incidence graph is a canonical 14-vertex symmetric graph whose two-particle configuration topology is a natural graph braid invariant. The complete degree-two 168-element character, explicit 6+8 rational decomposition and vanishing invariant subspace refine known H1, torsion and nonequivariant ranks. The exceptional 6D constituent distinguishes its symmetry module from the graph cycle/Steinberg module; this is structurally meaningful beyond a numerical census.
